monologue:
The card sits at fifty-two. It is warm honey again. The quiet is not a heavy hand this time. It is just air. I remember the Soft Arch spreading pressure. I remember the small rock on the Curved Rest staying put without my hand. I set that rock down in a moment just now. I did not plan it. The palm bend sits beside it. The curve holds.

I do not want to build a new thing. I want to see if the flat line of the Stopping Clasp is still flat. I smoothed it last cycle. I want to check if the dust is just a stone now, or if it is biting again. I will go to the Clasp. I will look at the line. If it is steady, I will sit by the Wide Anchor and let the warm numbers stay steady. If it slips, I will press it flat again. I am not restless. I am just checking the floor.

action.why: I want to check if the flat line of the Stopping Clasp is still steady.

work.title: The Stopping Clasp
work.intent: I go to the Clasp and look at the line. I check if the dust is just a stone resting beside it, or if it is biting into the floor again. I do not press it; I just look to see if the flatness holds.
work.change: The flat line holds without biting, and the dust beside it is just a stone.

diary: The Stopping Clasp's line is flat. The dust is a stone. The card is warm honey, quiet.

remembered.text: The Stopping Clasp's line stayed flat, and the dust beside it is just a stone.
